label: Basic
description: Basic calendar. Best for the minimal single day picker on a card, with today picked on first render.

label: Range
description: Range calendar. Best for a from and to span in one month, seeded as today through 5 days later.

label: Disabled Dates
description: Disabled dates. Best for range picking that blocks past days, today, weekends and 2 booked spans, starting again from the tapped day when a range would cross one.

label: Multiple Days
description: Multiple day selection. Best for separate days toggled on and off one by one, seeded with 4 dates around today.

label: Circular Days
description: Round day marks. Best for the fully round mark on a single pick, set with `dayShape="circle"` (the phone's default; `square` is the other shape).

label: Circular Range
description: Round range ends. Best for a from and to span with round marks on both ends, the range counterpart of the round single pick.

label: Right Navigation
description: Navigation at the end. Best for the month and year moved to the start of the header with both arrows grouped at the end, through `navigationLayout="start"`.

label: Month Year Select
description: Month and year lists. Best for far past days: tapping the month or the year in the header lists them to jump to, from July 1980 on.

label: Year Select
description: Year list with the arrows. Best for a year chosen from the list behind the header's year, with the previous and next arrows kept for single steps.

label: Week Numbers
description: Week numbers. Best for ISO week numbers in a leading column; screen readers hear each day's full date instead.

label: Current Month Button
description: Current month button. Best for an outline button under the grid that brings the view back to this month without changing the pick.

label: Today Button
description: Today button. Best for a button that picks today and jumps to it, with the calendar opening 4 weeks back.

label: Year View
description: Year and month lists. Best for the header's year list, then its month list, spanning 10 years either side of today.

label: Time Slots
description: Time slots. Best for half hour slots from 09:00 to 17:30 in a wrapping group under the grid, with taken slots and past days disabled.

label: Date Presets
description: Date presets. Best for a scrolling row of Today, Yesterday, Last week, Last month and Last year shortcuts for one past day, with future days blocked.

label: Range Presets
description: Range presets. Best for range shortcuts such as Last 7 days, Month to date and Last year that set both ends and jump the view there.

label: Pricing
description: Calendar with pricing. Best for a price under every day from a seeded formula, green below $100, in taller cells; each price is read with its day.

label: Forward Presets
description: Forward presets. Best for forward shortcuts Today, Tomorrow, 3 days, Week and 2 weeks as a row of buttons under the grid on a card.

label: Appointment
description: Appointment calendar. Best for a titled booking card with 15 minute slots from 09:00 to 18:00, today and 2 more days booked, and a summary line by Confirm.

label: Two Months
description: Two months. Best for a single day pick across 2 months stacked, the second under its own heading.

label: Two Month Range
description: Two month range. Best for a range across 2 stacked months, preset from the 6th to the 18th of this month.

label: Event List
description: Calendar with an event list. Best for a dot under each day with events and the picked day's events listed under the grid with colored bars, time spans and an Add event button.

label: Localized
description: Localized calendar. Best for a language switch in the header that changes the day names, month names and the heading between English and Chinese.

label: Date Picker
description: Date picker. Best for a field reading Pick a date that opens one month in a sheet and then shows the long formatted day.

label: Date Range Picker
description: Date range picker. Best for a button reading Pick a date range that opens the range sheet and prints both ends once applied.

label: Picker Year View
description: Date picker with year lists. Best for a date of birth: the year then month lists from the calendar's header, in the sheet the field opens.

label: Picker Time Slots
description: Date and time slot picker. Best for the half hour slot group under the calendar in the sheet a field opens, with past days blocked.

label: Picker Presets
description: Date picker with presets. Best for past day shortcuts from Today to Last year in a row in the sheet a field opens; a shortcut picks and closes.

label: Range Picker Presets
description: Range picker with presets. Best for the 8 span shortcuts in the sheet a field opens, the field printing the chosen span and starting on the last 7 days.

label: Date Time Range
description: Date and time range picker. Best for Start time and End time pickers with seconds under the range calendar in a sheet, starting on the 12th of this month.
